Hi Rajiv / AP team,

Following up on invoice INV-2026-334 for $42,750 — we noticed your virtual card provider is scheduled to rotate the token on the 26th (their window is 26–27 Jun). That token rotation often triggers card declines for recurring/one-off charges that rely on the stored token. Can you confirm whether you want Redwood to attempt the charge today, or would you prefer a wire/ACH fallback to ensure the payment posts before month-end?

Quick context: if we attempt the charge after the token rotates there is a small risk of an automatic decline and processing delay while you re-enter card details with your bank. If you want us to proceed on the card today we can queue the capture (requires your confirmation). Otherwise, I can provide wire instructions and we can mark this invoice for an immediate manual remittance.

Attachments: INV-2026-334.pdf (invoice) — I also attached our W-9 if your AP team needs it for remittance routing.

Requested next step: please reply with one of the options below by EOD 24 Jun so we can avoid any collection lag:
- Confirm charge attempt on current card (we will attempt today)
- Provide new card token or card-on-file update
- Confirm wire/ACH and we’ll send instructions (I attached a quick wire stub)

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Irene
